language.title: Grounded Reasoning
language.description: Language-led inference, evidence-linked training, distillation, and reliability. A longer trace is not necessarily better grounded; compare direct answers, visual ablations, and evidence-supported reasoning under matched budgets.

visual.title: Thinking in Visual Futures
visual.description: Generated frames, denoising trajectories, and visual updates as intermediate computation. Separate temporal steps inside a generated scene from refinement across diffusion steps. Image-output and general visual-reasoning bridges are labeled explicitly.

structured.title: Stateful Intelligence
structured.description: Graphs, object tracks, spatial maps, and continuous reasoning states. These representations preserve relations and identity; they do not automatically define executable dynamics. Memory built from observations must remain distinguishable from imagined state.

executable.title: Executable Worlds
executable.description: Programs and simulators connect inferred state, transitions, execution, and rendering. **Direct video systems**, **visual bridges**, and **planning foundations** are separated in the scope column. Scene reconstruction, program execution, and physical identification are distinct claims; see the [case study](../world-models.md).

agents.title: Active Video Agents
agents.description: Tool use, evidence search, reflection, and multi-agent coordination. Track what each tool observes and how the answer depends on it. Retrieval over a fully indexed recording is an offline access setting even when the answering loop is described as online.

streaming.title: Always-On Intelligence
streaming.description: Observed-prefix reasoning, memory updates, response timing, and proactive interaction. Report query-arrival rules, access to discarded frames, total retained history, and end-to-end latency. Streaming video generation belongs under world models rather than this understanding-oriented branch.

perception.title: Evidence at Scale
perception.description: Supporting methods for frame selection, token compression, temporal grounding, and audio-visual representations. These improve the evidence interface; efficiency gains alone do not establish a new reasoning mechanism. Report preprocessing, retrieval, and encoder costs as well as retained tokens.

worlds.title: World Models for Action
worlds.description: Visual prediction, latent dynamics, physical priors, and planning or policy learning from imagined futures. Renderer quality, action sensitivity, and decision utility require separate evaluation. Related planning foundations are marked where video transfer is not established.

benchmarks.title: Beyond Answer Accuracy
benchmarks.description: Benchmarks, training resources, and diagnostic studies covering evidence, time, memory, interaction, and physical consistency. Image-only and symbolic evaluations are marked as bridges. A diagnostic study need not release a standalone benchmark; compare protocols before scores.

surveys.title: Perspectives & Roadmaps
surveys.description: Surveys, theses, and position papers connecting video reasoning, spatial intelligence, multimodal interaction, and world modeling. Proposed taxonomies and future capabilities are viewpoints rather than demonstrated system results.
